w6z305cxkv When I buy a panel, I compare what it is worth TO ME (MPB) with its price. But each panel also reduces pollution for my neighbours: an external benefit (MEB = 20) that nobody in the transaction receives, so nobody counts it. The market stops where MPB = MPC (18 panels), whereas society, which also counts the neighbours (MSB = MPB + MEB), would want to go up to MSB = MSC (22). Panels 18 → 22 were worth more to society than they cost: that is the deadweight loss (40). A subsidy per panel equal to MEB(Q*) = 20 makes those panels worthwhile for the buyer and brings the market to 22.
